meta.name: broken-link-checker
meta.description: Scans a website to find broken links (404s, 500s). Crawls internal pages,  identifies broken outbound links, and reports source pages for easy fixing. Use this when the user asks to "check for broken links", "find 404s",  "audit my links", or "is my site healthy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描网站找出所有失效链接并报告来源页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期检查网站链接健康度，避免用户遇到404错误。
copy.tagline_en: Scan a website to find all broken links and report source pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly check your website for broken links and avoid 404 errors.

howto.what: 装上后，当你给出网址，Claude 会运行扫描脚本检查该网站最多 50 个页面，找出返回 404 或 5xx 错误的链接，并列出每个坏链接出现在哪个页面，最后按内部/外部和错误类型汇总，给出修改或删除建议。
howto.when: 当你说“检查失效链接”、“找 404”、“审查我的链接”等，或询问网站健康状况时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 https://example.com 的失效链接
say.note: Claude 会开始扫描该网站。

say.text: 查找 example.com 的 404 错误
say.note: Claude 会扫描并报告 404 链接及来源页面。

say.text: 审计一下我的网站链接健康吗
say.note: Claude 会运行扫描并汇总坏链接情况。

howto.what_en: After you give Claude a URL, it scans up to 50 pages for broken links (404/5xx), reports which pages each broken link appears on, and summarizes by internal/external with fix suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “check for broken links”, “find 404s”, “audit my links”, etc., or ask whether your site is healthy.

say_en.note: Claude will start scanning the site.
Claude will scan and report 404s with source pages.

say_en.text: Audit my website for link health
say_en.note: Claude will run the scan and summarize broken links.
